PIPELINE LESSONS (measured this run): (a) proven_by is the union since the latest FORWARD BUILDME, so dropping a proof needs a kick-back to TICKETME, then BUILDME, then PROVEME; a back-edge to BUILDME keeps the old names. (b) cross.py takes proofs as separate argv entries; a comma-joined string becomes one phantom proof. (c) PROVEME names only the proofs whose PROVES dict declares the ticket; regression proofs stay out. (d) An UNWRIT hollow line is a finding against the chart: re-berth decompose->triage->hypothesize->validate through each writer, repointing each *_ref. (e) The PROVED clearance runs build_inspector over the component (sole_path, working_tree_clean, history_integrity) and the_stones_are_pushed, so commit and push both repos before crossing. The rehearse --proved divergence list for 48519f4789b1 names unproved decision steps (STALE root/stamp, CONCURRENCY RLocks, D14 no crossing post). It is recorded, not a red.
